description: Installations photovoltaïques au sol is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Institut national de l'information géographique et forestière. Installations de production photovoltaïque au sol Une base de données nationale pour recenser les installations photovoltaïques au sol Caractéristiques principales: • Localisation des installations de production photovoltaïque au sol, détectées par IA • Informations administratives et techniques issues de déclarations des porteurs de projets photovoltaïque • Permet la prise en compte des exemptions au décompte ... Coverage: Institut national de l'information géographique et forestière. The publisher named on the listing is Institut national de l'information géographique et forestière. Its keywords include developpement-durable, sobriete-fonciere, photovoltaique, donnees-ouvertes, occupation-du-sol, inspire. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WMTS, WMS. The listing shows 2025-11-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
